reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Tobi Lütke, co-founder and CEO of Shopify.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Tobi Lütke, co-founder and CEO of Shopify. Having first spoken to Tobi at the beginning of the pandemic, just two months into it. Among many things, we discuss Shopify’s evolution into the world of atoms-based building through Shopify’s fulfillment network, the value of infrastructure writ large.
